name: Matsumoto
source:
The main protagonist of Memories~ Guardians of the Goddess.  
Cold and distant on the outside, but warm and affectionate to those who are close to her.
She’s tasked with helping Yōkais so they can rest in peace.

Her name by default is "Haruna"
